privCard_silver: A practical starter rank that unlocks handy everyday commands, quick access to your storage and inventory, player teleport and private-message controls, plus land claims, extra homes and an hourly in-game salary.
privCardFull_silver: Get the SILVER kit and enjoy useful gameplay, instant access to workbench, ender chest and inventory, player teleportation, and private message control. You’ll also get 4 auction slots, 2 land claims, 2 sethome points, and earn $50 per hour in-game. A practical upgrade for smoother and more comfortable gameplay.
privCard_supreme: A step up with cosmetic and social perks, personal weather control, more auction slots and land claims, extra homes, and a higher hourly salary for more comfortable play.
privCardFull_supreme: Unlock the SUPREME kit and enjoy advanced perks like wearing items as a hat, ignoring players, checking last visits, and changing your personal weather. You’ll also get 6 auction slots, 4 land claims, 4 sethome points, and earn $100 per hour in-game. A powerful upgrade for players who want maximum control and extra benefits.
privCard_wither: A premium tier that adds admin-chat access, nearby-player and server-info tools, the ability to extinguish yourself, expanded auctions and regions, more homes, and an even higher salary.
privCardFull_wither: Unlock the WITHER kit and gain perks like access to admin chat, viewing nearby players, extinguishing yourself, and checking server information. You'll also get 8 auction slots, 6 land claims, 6 sethome points, and earn $150 per hour in-game. A premium choice for players who want more comfort and a higher salary.
privCard_hero: A high-level rank with broadcast tools, teleport controls, and generous auction, region, home and salary boosts.
privCardFull_hero: Unlock the HERO kit and enjoy perks like broadcasting ads, teleport controls, and server information. You'll also receive 12 auction slots, 8 land claims, 8 sethome points, and earn $200 per hour in-game. A strong upgrade with generous limits.
privCard_avenger: Take charge of your world with nickname and full time-and-weather control, and greatly expanded auctions, regions, homes and salary.
privCardFull_avenger: Take control of your gameplay with the AVENGER kit. Change your nickname and control time and weather. You'll also get 22 auction slots, the ability to claim up to 50 regions, set 50 homes, and earn $250 per hour in-game. Designed for dedicated players who want more freedom and large-scale building potential.
privCard_legend: A high-tier rank with colored chat, plus large auction, region and home limits and a strong salary.
privCardFull_legend: Step up with the LEGEND kit and colored chat. You'll receive 30 auction slots, the ability to claim up to 99 regions, set 99 homes, and earn $250 per hour in-game.
privCard_phantom: An elite tier with huge auction, region and home limits and a high salary.
privCardFull_phantom: Enter the server with the PHANTOM kit. You'll receive 60 auction slots, the ability to claim up to 199 regions, set 199 homes, and earn $300 per hour in-game. An exclusive tier with large limits and a high hourly salary.
privCard_phoenix: The ultimate rank with custom prefixes and priority join, topped with the largest limits and salary on the server.
privCardFull_phoenix: Rise with the PHOENIX kit: set a custom prefix and join a full server. You'll receive 100 auction slots, the ability to claim up to 299 regions, set 299 homes, and earn $400 per hour in-game. The top rank for prestige and the largest limits on the server.
